questions.question: Which variance describes a new noisy reading at a given input?
options: Only the posterior variance of the intercept
The propagated weight uncertainty plus observation-noise variance
The training mean squared error divided by the number of weights
questions.explanation: Both the unknown line and a new independent observation error contribute. Omitting the latter gives an interval for the latent mean, not for a future reading.
optionFeedback: A future prediction depends on all relevant coefficient uncertainty at its input, including covariance, plus observation noise.
Both the unknown line and a new independent observation error contribute. Omitting the latter gives an interval for the latent mean, not for a future reading.
Training MSE divided by parameter count is not this posterior predictive calculation. Propagate the coefficient covariance through the new input.
